submitted.rationale: I spread all 5 EQE measurements across the line (Sb 0.23, 0.39, 0.52, 0.65, 0.85). Every value was around 1e-4 % or lower, which is effectively zero photoresponse at 2.1 eV illumination and pH 1.4. Index 1 (Sb 0.227, Cu-rich) gave the highest positive reading, 1.1e-4 %. The Cu-rich end is the most plausible active region, since phase mixtures containing CuO absorb below 2.1 eV.
